mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 32 degrees under overcast skies at the high school, and we are seeing a full moon tonight. The overnight low will be 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available, with a January 5 submission deadline, and residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15 with payment options available online or at the City Center drop box.
There is plenty to do in town, starting today with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee, followed by trivia at the Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from November 6, officers responded to a report of a driver slumped over in a parking lot, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
You can satisfy your cravings with today's delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence flavor, and since we are currently open until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
